hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: First check whether the combined multiset of values in array A and array B has even frequencies for all numbers.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: If any value appears an odd number of times overall, making the two arrays identical multisets is impossible.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Calculate the excess counts of elements in A compared to the target distribution and sum differences divided by 2.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Counts element frequencies and computes excess transfers in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all permutations of swap choices results in exponential search.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores frequency distributions across unique elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies parity feasibility condition and greedily matches excess elements.
